title: CIA screening genetic databases for Nordic markers

tellings.quote: "Look, we know that Kit Green at the CIA has some program to access the 23 and me and like whatever ancestry.com databases

plain: A man named Kit Green, said to be at the CIA, the US spy agency, is said to run a program that taps into consumer DNA-testing databases such as 23andMe and Ancestry.com to search for Nordic genetic markers. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show, passing on what a man named Lyn Buchanan told him: "we know that Kit Green at the CIA has some program to access the 23 and me and like whatever ancestry.com databases." If true, the government would be quietly screening people's genes for a particular ancestry.
